name: Paddle
summary: Paddle is a payment platform that acts as the legal seller for your software, handling global sales tax and VAT for you.

free_plan_covers.note: No monthly fee or user cap; you only pay per completed checkout (5% + 50 cents, tax handling included).

first_paid_usd_month.note: No monthly plan; pricing is pay-per-transaction with no setup, monthly, or migration fees.

portability.note: Proprietary checkout and merchant-of-record relationship; moving to another provider needs a real rebuild of billing and tax setup.

merchant_of_record.note: Paddle is merchant of record on every sale: it registers for, collects, files, and remits sales tax and VAT for you.

subscriptions.note: Native subscription and recurring billing management is included in the core product.

fee_summary.note: Single all-inclusive rate that bundles payment processing, fraud protection, and global tax compliance.

setup.step: Create a Paddle account, starting in sandbox mode for testing before applying for a live account.
Create a server-side API key and a client-side token under Paddle > Developer Tools > Authentication.
Set your API key, client token, and environment (sandbox or production) as environment variables.
Create a notification destination pointed at your app's /api/webhook route and copy its signing secret.
Use Paddle.js on the client to open a checkout, and verify webhook signatures on the server to fulfill orders.

builder_notes: Keep PADDLE_API_KEY on the server; only the client token is safe to expose to the browser.
Verify webhook signatures before updating subscription or order state in your database.
Let Paddle handle sales tax and VAT; do not build separate tax calculation logic on top of it.
